title: Strongly Adaptive Online Learning with Time-Varying Movement Costs
abstract: arXiv:2610.32740v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study strongly adaptive regret for Online Convex Optimization (OCO) with time-varying movement costs, a setting that evaluates a learner's performance over arbitrary sub-intervals. This framework captures complex sequential decision-making problems where both the environment and the cost of switching decisions fluctuate over time. We propose a novel algorithm which, for any interval $[a,b] \subseteq [T]$, achieves a data-dependent regret bound of $ \widetilde{\mathcal{O}}\left( \sqrt{(D^2+DP_{[a,b]})\sum_{t \in [a,b]}(\|g_t\|^2+\lambda_t\|g_t\|)} \right) $, where $D$ is the diameter of the decision domain, $P_{[a,b]}$ is the path length of the comparator sequence over $[a,b]$, $g_t$ is the gradient of the loss, and $\lambda_t$ is the movement-cost coefficient at round $t$. translated_title: 具有时变移动代价的强自适应在线学习
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.32740v1 公告类型：cross 摘要：我们研究了具有时变移动代价的在线凸优化（OCO）的强自适应遗憾，该设定用于评估学习者在任意子区间上的性能。这一框架刻画了复杂的序列决策问题，其中环境与切换决策的代价均随时间波动。我们提出了一种新颖的算法，对于任意区间 $[a,b] \subseteq [T]$，可实现数据依赖的遗憾界 $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}\left( \sqrt{(D^2+DP_{[a,b]})\sum_{t \in [a,b]}(\|g_t\|^2+\lambda_t\|g_t\|)} \right)$，其中 $D$ 为决策域的直径，$P_{[a,b]}$ 为比较序列在 $[a,b]$ 上的路径长度，$g_t$ 为损失的梯度，$\lambda_t$ 为第 $t$ 轮的移动代价系数。我们方法的关键在于一种新颖的归约，将问题转化为带移动代价的睡眠专家问题，这是一个此前未被探索过、且具有独立研究价值的变体。作为……
tldr: 本文提出了一种针对时变移动代价在线凸优化的强自适应算法，通过新颖地归约到此前未被探索的带移动代价的睡眠专家问题，在任意时间区间上实现了数据依赖的遗憾界。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a strongly adaptive algorithm for online convex optimization with time-varying movement costs, achieving a data-dependent regret bound over arbitrary intervals via a novel reduction to a previously unexplored variant of sleeping experts with movement costs.
